mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, u.username AS teacher_name, c.name AS class_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=a.id) AS submission_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=a.id AND status='graded') AS graded_count FROM assignment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.teacher_id=u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON a.class_id=c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment (title, description, teacher_id, class_id, due_date, max_score, rubric, attachments, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{dueDate}, #{maxScore}, #{rubric}, #{attachments}, #{status})
mapper.select: WHERE a.teacher_id=#{teacherId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
WHERE a.class_id=#{classId} ORDER BY a.due_date DESC
WHERE a.class_id IN (SELECT class_id FROM class_member WHERE user_id=#{studentId}) AND a.status='published' ORDER BY a.due_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_submission (assignment_id, student_id, content, file_url, status) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_submission SET content=#{content}, ai_score=#{aiScore}, ai_feedback=#{aiFeedback}, teacher_score=#{teacherScore}, teacher_feedback=#{teacherFeedback}, grade_time=NOW(), status=#{status}, submit_time=submit_time WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.username AS student_name, a.title AS assignment_title FROM assignment_submission s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id=u.id LEFT JOIN assignment a ON s.assignment_id=a.id WHERE s.id=#{id}
SELECT s.*, u.username AS student_name FROM assignment_submission s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id=u.id WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY s.submit_time DESC
SELECT s.*, a.title AS assignment_title FROM assignment_submission s LEFT JOIN assignment a ON s.assignment_id=a.id WHERE s.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY s.submit_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND status='graded'
